Four aboard at 9,934 feet. ✈️

On November 19, Tecnam US chief pilot Doma Andreka and three passengers took a diesel-powered P2010 TDI from Centennial Airport near Denver to Leadville, Colorado. They cruised at 13,000 feet and touched down at Lake County Airport, where the runway sits nearly two miles above sea level.

Then came the part worth watching: the crew refueled and took off again with all four seats occupied. Tecnam reported using less than half of Leadville’s 6,400-foot runway on that departure. One piston single, a full cabin, and the Rockies out the window. That’s a good day of flying.
